businesses.business: industrial technology (test and measurement, facility safety and software)

offering_description.value: Designs and makes professional instruments, sensors, software and services for industrial and commercial customers. Products include electronic test and measurement tools, facility and worker safety and compliance solutions, and asset and equipment management software. Sold to businesses and institutions mainly through distributors and direct sales.

primary_products.value: electronic test and measurement instruments; gas detection and safety equipment; thermal imaging cameras; calibration and sensing devices; asset management software

primary_services.value: software subscriptions; calibration and repair services; compliance and safety services; maintenance management software

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial manufacturers, electricians, utilities, healthcare facilities, data centers, contractors, and electronics makers; B2G: government agencies and public facilities

end_markets.value: industrial manufacturing; electronics and semiconductors; utilities and energy; healthcare; construction and facilities; data centers

revenue_model.value: product sales: test instruments, sensors, safety devices and related equipment; subscription: recurring software and cloud-based asset and compliance management; service fees: calibration, repair and maintenance services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and sensors from purchased components, sold to industrial and commercial users; software / platform: provides asset, maintenance and compliance software to facilities and enterprises; service provider: calibration and repair services for installed equipment
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: intelligent operating solutions, precision technologies, advanced healthcare solutions, all focused on instruments, software and services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: industrial and electrical distributors; direct sales: sales teams serving enterprise and software customers; online: e-commerce and web sales of instruments and software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety, environmental and workplace safety standards, some healthcare-related compliance such as FDA rules

notes: Fortive's portfolio has changed through spin-offs and divestitures; segment mix described is approximate and may be out of date.
